title: The Breakfast Club
description: This pack aims to be a new experience for players, with vanilla plus additions and magitech content!
body:
The Breakfast Club is a community of people who love all sorts of games, Minecraft being one of them! This pack was created as a community and is the culmination of several minds working together.

**Adventure!**

With mods such as Geophilic, Climate Rivers, Stony Cliffs are Cool, and Blast from the Past, adventuring in your world will feel both fresh and akin to vanilla at the same time.

![The new Frostbite Forest.](https://images2.imgbox.com/8d/2c/RSovubzi_o.png)

**Technology!**

This pack utilises Create and a host of its addons to give the player creative freedom to build any machine, for any purpose.

![A schematicannon ready to create a structure.](https://images2.imgbox.com/cd/34/0KwgAhg4_o.png)

**Magic!**

This pack includes Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks which adds a myriad of spells for utility and combat! A few armour mods have been included to add further end-game gathering after Netherite which add to the magical feel!

![A spellblade in his citadel.](https://images2.imgbox.com/ef/d0/rnHe2Acn_o.png)

Overall, there is a bit of everything for everyone whilst not overloading the player (or a server lol). We hope you enjoy the pack!
